Quick engineering note (summary):
- Provisioning timeline: EU primary (6 weeks), EU DR (2 additional weeks), APAC cold-standby (optional physical image + config: 4–6 weeks). Total end-to-end for all: ~10–12 weeks if done in parallel; 8–10 if some steps overlap.
- Work required: new VPC constructs per enclave, cross-account IAM for HSM access, HSM key provisioning per tenancy, route53/geolocation DNS, and network ACLs for regulatory segregation.
- Isolation: we recommend one dedicated VPC per enclave + a unique KMS key per enclave for complete cryptographic isolation. This will add ~5% to provisioning time and a fixed monthly KMS charge per key.
- Risk: synchronous replication between eu-west and eu-north will add complexity and latency; recommend async replication for logs and periodic snapshots for DR.

I filled the estimate sheet with CPU/GPU ramp scenarios (see tab 'Medivio-v1'). If they confirm GPU units per enclave, we can firm up cost.

— Priyom
